state.project: Miu World: 3D voxel learn-while-playing online game for all ages (kids and adults), web now, mobile app later; online always on; friends by request+accept; parties of 2-4; companion bots (labelled) with their own personas; only the owner and one child play today, outsiders later.
state.owner_request: When players are friends or in a party they can talk to each other by voice. Bots can voice too.
facts: Today: canned chat lines and emotes only; block and report exist; the game reads text aloud with on-device speech synthesis only (no remote voices).
A speaking-step recorder already uses the microphone and never sends or stores audio.
Production web/API sits behind Cloudflare on a shared host; the origin IP is hidden; only HTTPS/WebSocket is open.
WebRTC peer-to-peer audio works for most home networks with STUN; some mobile/school networks need a TURN relay.

criteria.party_and_friends: Party members share one party voice channel; outside a party, a player can start a voice call with a friend from the friends list (friend accepts). Never with strangers or nearby non-friends.
criteria.proximity_everyone: Everyone nearby in the world hears each other.

criteria.off_by_default_open_or_ptt: Mic off until the player taps the mic button; then open mic with voice detection, push-to-talk available in settings; speaking ring on avatar and party frame; per-person mute and volume; blocking someone cuts voice both ways; no recording ever, audio never stored.
criteria.always_open: Mic opens automatically when joining a party.

criteria.tts_persona_react: Bots speak their lines aloud with on-device synthesized voices, each bot its own pitch/speed from its persona; they react to a player speaking (turn-taking, short fitting voiced replies, emotes) without transcribing the player's speech.
criteria.tts_plus_speech_recognition: Bots also transcribe players' speech (browser speech recognition, which may send audio to a vendor) to answer what was said.

criteria.webrtc_mesh_cloudflare_turn: WebRTC peer-to-peer mesh (max 4) with signalling over the existing game WebSocket; Cloudflare's free STUN; Cloudflare's managed TURN relay as fallback (free tier far above expected use; needs the owner to create a TURN key); origin IP stays hidden, no new ports.
criteria.webrtc_mesh_selfhosted_turn: Same, but run a TURN server on the shared production host (open UDP/TCP ports, exposes the origin IP).
criteria.server_relay_over_websocket: Encode audio in the browser and relay it through the game server over the existing WebSocket (no WebRTC; higher latency; needs an Opus encoder library).

criteria.privacy_line_keep_consent_v3: Keep consent v3; add privacy-page lines: voice goes directly between players (or via the relay), is never recorded or stored by the game.
criteria.new_consent_v4: Bump consent to v4 and ask everyone again.
